scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
Although I need help with a task, you are not strong enough to assist me, noob~!
scripts.translation:
[不悦的皇家卫士]
虽然我有任务需要帮忙，但你太弱了，帮不上忙，菜鸟~！

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
Come back later when you have done some training and are at least level 120!
scripts.translation:
[不悦的皇家卫士]
等你训练好，至少达到120级后再来吧！

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
I can only open the secret passage for party leaders. Please have your party leader talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[不悦的皇家卫士]
我只能为队伍首领开启秘密通道。请让你的队伍首领来和我说话。

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
Have you found the princess yet?! Is she safe?
scripts.translation:
[不悦的皇家卫士]
你找到公主了吗？！她安全吗？

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
The monsters around the secret passage have disappeared. Now is our chance to save the princess!
scripts.translation:
[不悦的皇家卫士]
秘密通道周围的魔物已经消失了。现在是拯救公主的机会！

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
I need help, even from the likes of you.
scripts.translation:
[不悦的皇家卫士]
我需要帮助，即使是像你这样的人。

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
In the middle of battle the princess disappeared while I was guarding the palace.
scripts.translation:
[不悦的皇家卫士]
战斗正酣时，我在守卫皇宫，公主却失踪了。

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
You run ahead and I will catch up. We must save her.
scripts.translation:
[不悦的皇家卫士]
你先跑在前面，我会赶上的。我们必须救她。

scripts.text: I will help.
scripts.translation: 我会帮忙。

scripts.text: This is not a good time.
scripts.translation: 现在不是时候。

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
Even now all the royal guards are fighting and dying from the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[不悦的皇家卫士]
即使现在，所有的皇家卫士都在与魔物战斗并牺牲。

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
We must, no matter how much fear grips our hearts, save the princess!
scripts.translation:
[不悦的皇家卫士]
无论心中多么恐惧，我们都必须拯救公主！

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
Thank you..
I will open the secret passage to the ^0000ffGhost Palace^000000.
Please be ready!
scripts.translation:
[不悦的皇家卫士]
谢谢你...
我将开启通往^0000ff幽灵皇宫^000000的秘密通道。
请做好准备！

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
Althought I need help with a task, you are not strong enough to assist me, noob~!
scripts.translation:
[不悦的皇家卫士]
虽然我有任务需要帮忙，但你太弱了，帮不上忙，菜鸟~！

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
Come back later when you have done some training and are at least level 120!
scripts.translation:
[不悦的皇家卫士]
等你训练好，至少达到120级后再来吧！

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
I can see the secret passage into the palace. Are you ready to save the princess?!
scripts.translation:
[不悦的皇家卫士]
我能看到通往皇宫的秘密通道。你准备好拯救公主了吗？！

scripts.text: Enter
scripts.translation: 进入

scripts.text: Stop
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
Even now all the royal guards are fighting and dying from the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[不悦的皇家卫士]
即使现在，所有的皇家卫士都在与魔物战斗并牺牲。

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
We must, no matter how much fear grips our hearts, save the princess!
scripts.translation:
[不悦的皇家卫士]
无论心中多么恐惧，我们都必须拯救公主！

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
The monsters that attacked the palace are wandering around the secret entrance. It would be very bad if they spotted us... Please wait.
scripts.translation:
[不悦的皇家卫士]
攻击皇宫的魔物在秘密入口附近徘徊。如果它们发现我们就糟了...请等一下。

scripts.text:
When the time limit for the entrance is up
let's try to re-enter.
scripts.translation:
当入口的时间限制结束时
让我们尝试重新进入。

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe time limit for entering to the Curse of the Swordsman is finished. Please try to talk to the Unpleasent Royal Guard again..^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff进入剑士诅咒的时间限制已结束。请再次与不悦的皇家卫士交谈。^000000

scripts.text:
[Unpleasant Royal Guard]
I can only open the secret passage for party leaders. Please have your party leader talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[不悦的皇家卫士]
我只能为队伍首领开启秘密通道。请让你的队伍首领来和我说话。

scripts.text: An unknown error occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生了一个未知错误。

scripts.text: ^ff0000Inside the devices you see a dark hole. If you wish to enter you must to talk to the Unpleasent Royal Guard first.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000在装置内部，你看到一个黑暗的空洞。如果你想进入，必须先与不悦的皇家卫士交谈。^000000

scripts.text: Only registered members can enter the {0} instance.
scripts.translation: 只有注册成员才能进入{0}副本。

scripts.text:
[King]
You are hereby appointed as the personal guard to Princess Tiara. I trust your loyalty above all else.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
我在此任命你为蒂亚拉公主的贴身护卫。我信任你的忠诚胜过一切。

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
I will protect the princess with my life.
scripts.translation:
[阴沉的皇家卫士]
我愿以性命守护公主。

scripts.text:
[King]
The marriage arrangements are going as planned. The prince is here to meet with the princess.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
婚事正按计划进行。王子已抵达，准备与公主会面。

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
...Yes, Your Majesty.
scripts.translation:
[阴沉的皇家卫士]
...遵命，陛下。

scripts.text:
[King]
My gods, there are monsters in the castle! Get rid of them now!
scripts.translation:
[国王]
天哪，城堡里有魔物！立刻消灭它们！

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
Your Highness, the King has invited a prince from a neighboring country to be your betrothed. Be ready to meet him...
scripts.translation:
[阴沉的皇家卫士]
殿下，国王陛下邀请了邻国的王子作为您的未婚夫。请做好见面的准备...

scripts.text:
[Princess Tiara]
If...If a marriage is arranged what should I do?
scripts.translation:
[蒂亚拉公主]
如...如果婚事已经安排好了，我该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
The only thing I can do is protect you from physical harm.
scripts.translation:
[阴沉的皇家卫士]
我能做的，只有保护您免受身体上的伤害。

scripts.text:
[Princess Tiara]
Then, what can I do?
scripts.translation:
[蒂亚拉公主]
那么，我能做什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
You must decide that for yourself Your Highness...
scripts.translation:
[阴沉的皇家卫士]
殿下，这件事必须由您自己决定...

scripts.text:
[Princess Tiara]
Would it be easier for you if I were married and sent off to another country?
scripts.translation:
[蒂亚拉公主]
如果我嫁出去，被送往他国，对你来说会轻松一些吗？

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
I will always stand by you and protect you forever.
scripts.translation:
[阴沉的皇家卫士]
我会永远陪伴在您身边，守护您。

scripts.text:
[Princess Tiara]
Monsters have gotten inside the castle? Please, protect me!
scripts.translation:
[蒂亚拉公主]
魔物闯进城堡了？请保护我！

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
Stay behind me. Let's go!
scripts.translation:
[阴沉的皇家卫士]
躲在我身后。我们走！

scripts.text:
[King]
It was you who brought the monsters here! You want to get rid of me and have the princess for yourself?
scripts.translation:
[国王]
是你把魔物引来的！你想除掉我，独占公主吗？

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
It is a trap Your Majesty! You must trust me!
scripts.translation:
[阴沉的皇家卫士]
陛下，这是个陷阱！请相信我！

scripts.text:
[King]
Shut up! You've betrayed me! I trusted you... you must pay for your disgrace.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
闭嘴！你背叛了我！我曾信任你...你必须为你的耻辱付出代价。

scripts.text:
[King]
You will suffer for the rest of your life.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
你将余生都在痛苦中度过。

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
Where is Princess Tiara?
scripts.translation:
[阴沉的皇家卫士]
蒂亚拉公主在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Visiting Prince]
You are too late... but you brought what I was looking for. Thanks for your help.
scripts.translation:
[来访的王子]
你来得太晚了...不过你带来了我在找的东西。谢谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Visiting Prince]
Cursed Magic Sword Tartanos! Are you ready to have a new master?
scripts.translation:
[来访的王子]
被诅咒的魔剑 塔尔塔诺斯！你准备好迎接新的主人了吗？

scripts.text:
[Magic Sword Tartanos]
How dare you!
scripts.translation:
[魔剑 塔尔塔诺斯]
你竟敢如此！

scripts.text:
[Visiting Prince]
aah, aah !!!
scripts.translation:
[来访的王子]
啊...啊啊！！

scripts.text:
[Princess Tiara]
You kept your promise.
scripts.translation:
[蒂亚拉公主]
你遵守了诺言。

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
princess!
scripts.translation:
[阴沉的皇家卫士]
公主！

scripts.text:
[Princess Tiara]
Thank you... now I can rest beside you...
scripts.translation:
[蒂亚拉公主]
谢谢你...现在我可以安息在你身边了...

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
No..No!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[阴沉的皇家卫士]
不...不！！！！

scripts.text:
[The voice of Princess Tiara]
I want to be with you forever in peace...forever...
scripts.translation:
[蒂亚拉公主的声音]
我想永远和你在一起...永远...在宁静中...

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
no.....Ahh ahh ahh!!!!~!
scripts.translation:
[阴沉的皇家卫士]
不.....啊 啊 啊！！！！~！

scripts.text:
[The voice of Princess Tiara]
I love you...
scripts.translation:
[蒂亚拉公主的声音]
我爱你...

scripts.text:
[Lurid Royal Guard]
Are you satisfied..? Magic Sword Tartanos?
scripts.translation:
[阴沉的皇家卫士]
你满意了吗..？魔剑 塔尔塔诺斯？

scripts.text:
[Magic Sword Tartanos]
I need more blood..Sakray, offer me his blood.
scripts.translation:
[魔剑 塔尔塔诺斯]
我需要更多的鲜血..萨克雷，把他的血献给我。

scripts.text:
[Sakray]
Okay, that is good. A traveller. Did you see?
scripts.translation:
[萨克雷]
很好，就是这样。一个旅行者。你看到了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sakray, what do you want? Sympathy? Or is it a trap?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
萨克雷，你想要什么？同情？还是这是个陷阱？

scripts.text:
[Sakray]
No... I do not need to make any effort to catch a novice.
scripts.translation:
[萨克雷]
不...我不需要费力气去抓一个初心者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If so... then why...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果是这样...那么为什么...？

scripts.text:
[Sakray]
I wanted to get rid of a piece of humanity inside of me through you.
scripts.translation:
[萨克雷]
我想通过你，摆脱我内心残存的人性。

scripts.text:
[Sakray]
I am quite satisfied with the result.
scripts.translation:
[萨克雷]
我对结果相当满意。

scripts.text:
[Magic Sword Tartanos]
Sakray, offer the blood to me now!
scripts.translation:
[魔剑 塔尔塔诺斯]
萨克雷，现在就把血献给我！

scripts.text:
[Sakray]
If you were me, what would you do?
scripts.translation:
[萨克雷]
如果你是我，你会怎么做？

scripts.text:
[Sakray]
Can you set yourself free from this curse?
scripts.translation:
[萨克雷]
你能摆脱这个诅咒吗？

scripts.text:
[Sakray]
Heh heh... I will keep watching you until the day comes when you are old enough.
scripts.translation:
[萨克雷]
呵呵呵...我会一直注视着你，直到你长大成人。

scripts.text:
[Sakray]
I am willing to hunt you later for Tartanos.
scripts.translation:
[萨克雷]
为了塔尔塔诺斯，我日后会猎杀你的。

scripts.text:
[Sakray]
Farewell then.
scripts.translation:
[萨克雷]
那么，再见了。

scripts.text:
[King]
Hey there, are you alive?
I did not expect to meet someone who is still alive.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
嘿，你活着吗？
没想到还能遇到活人。

scripts.text:
[King]
Do you possibly have the ^006400{0}^000000?
Can you give it to me?
The memories of the faithful royal guard
and the memories of everyone he loved
are contained inside of these shards.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
你身上有^006400{0}^000000吗？
能给我吗？
忠诚的皇家卫士的记忆，
以及他深爱的所有人的记忆，
都蕴含在这些碎片之中。

scripts.text:
[King]
Will you give the ^006400{0}^000000 to me?
The guilt is eating my soul.
My soul is trapped inside the Ghost Palace.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
你愿意把^006400{0}^000000给我吗？
愧疚正在吞噬我的灵魂。
我的灵魂被困在幽灵皇宫里。

scripts.text:
[King]
I am collecting Sakray's abandoned memories from these shards.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
我正在从这些碎片中收集萨克雷遗失的记忆。

scripts.text:
[King]
If you give any ^006400{0}^000000s to me, I can make equipment for you.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
如果你给我^006400{0}^000000，我可以为你制作装备。

scripts.text:
[King]
The cursed knight...
Please help me save the soul of Sakray.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
被诅咒的骑士...
请帮帮我，拯救萨克雷的灵魂。

scripts.text:
[King]
Someday, Sakray will
get out of this curse for sure.
I believe
^006400{0}^000000s are the only method
to save him....
scripts.translation:
[国王]
总有一天，萨克雷一定能摆脱这个诅咒。
我相信
^006400{0}^000000是拯救他的唯一方法....

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Hand over {0} {1}.

[King]
Someday, Sakray will
get out of this curse for sure.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
总有一天，萨克雷一定能摆脱这个诅咒。

scripts.text: You see a light through the folded hands of the king and it gradually takes on a shape.
scripts.translation: 你看到国王合十的双手间透出一缕光芒，它逐渐凝聚成形。

scripts.text:
[King]
All right, it is done.
Take this ^FF0000{0}^000000
to confront Sakray and Tartanos.
scripts.translation:
[国王]
好了，完成了。
拿着这把^FF0000{0}^000000，
去直面萨克雷和塔尔塔诺斯吧。

scripts.text:
[King]
The power requires a sacrifice.
Please be careful...
scripts.translation:
[国王]
这股力量需要牺牲。
请小心...

scripts.text:
It is time to leave the Ghost Palace.
Everything is now complete
and will vanish..
scripts.translation:
是时候离开幽灵皇宫了。
一切既已完成，
也将随之消散..
